acceptance_criteria: Both old and new default books reported in updated. §4.2 example verified.
close_reason: MockBackend now stores AddressBooks, applies patches with single-default invariant; re-fetch after onSuccessSetIsDefault adds demoted book to updated; test set_on_success_reports_demoted_book_in_updated; 21 pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Contacts-10 §2.3 citing RFC 8620 §5.3: any changed objects must appear in created or updated. The §4.2 example shows BOTH the new default (isDefault:true) AND the old default (isDefault:false) in updated. Currently only the target book is reported.

**Algorithm:**
1. Choose approach: after update_object for the target book, call backend.get_objects::<AddressBook>(&account_id, None, Some(&["id","isDefault"])) to find books whose isDefault changed.
   Alternatively: extend MockBackend to implement single-default invariant (setting one default clears others and returns all changed books from update_object).
2. Add all changed books (those whose isDefault changed from true to false) to the updated map with their new values.
3. Add test set_on_success_demoted_book_in_updated: pre-seed two address books (one isDefault=true); pass onSuccessSetIsDefault targeting the second; assert BOTH books appear in updated (one gaining true, one losing). Oracle: §4.2 example.
4. cargo test -p jmap-contacts-server.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Old default book appears in updated with isDefault:false when default transfers. Oracle: §4.2, §2.3.
- New default book appears in updated with isDefault:true.
- cargo test exits 0.
title: Fix: report demoted book in updated when isDefault transfers
